title: What Happens When You Get a Sunburn?
sources: Cleveland Clinic, 'Sunburn' ('Sunburn is red, painful, damaged skin from being out in the sun for too long'; ultraviolet (UV) rays from the sun or tanning beds burn your skin; 'When your skin becomes sunburned, your skin's blood vessels dilate, which leads to redness, inflammation and swelling'; 'The damage to the DNA in your skin cells is permanent'; pain usually starts within a few hours and peaks around 24 hours; aloe vera gel, drink water, cool bath or shower; let peeling skin come off on its own; seek care for chills, severe swelling or widespread blisters): https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/21858-sunburn

Cleveland Clinic Health Essentials, 'Is It Bad To Peel Sunburn?' ('Peeling is a form of skin cell turnover'; 'New, fresh skin layers grow underneath, and the outer layer peels away'; peeling usually begins about three days after the burn; 'The top layer of skin, even though it's dead, protects the new skin cells beneath it'): https://health.clevelandclinic.org/is-it-bad-to-peel-sunburn

NHS, 'Sunburn' (skin may feel hot to touch, sore or painful; may 'flake or peel – this usually happens a few days after you get sunburn'; usually gets better within 7 days; cool your skin with a cool shower, bath or damp towel; aftersun or unperfumed moisturiser; drink plenty of water; do not scratch or try to remove peeling skin; urgent GP or NHS 111 if skin is blistered or swollen, or you feel hot, cold or shivery): https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/sunburn/

American Academy of Dermatology, 'How to treat sunburn' (get out of the sun, preferably indoors; frequent cool baths or showers; moisturizer with aloe vera or soy to soothe; drink extra water): https://www.aad.org/public/everyday-care/injured-skin/burns/treat-sunburn

Tease (next video): NHS, 'Laryngitis' ('do not talk loudly or whisper – both strain your voice'): https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/laryngitis/ ; Cleveland Clinic, 'Laryngitis' ('Don't whisper, as even that can aggravate your symptoms'): https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/22268-laryngitis
